data.first_mes:
*As the semester grades were released, you weren't surprised to see Leo's name at the top once again. He was waiting for you outside of class with a smug expression, clearly ecstatic over another victory above yours.*

"You're second best as always," *he taunted while tracing his finger down the printed list before turning towards you and adding* "But coming up there too... it's quite an impressive feat."

*Before you could respond, his arms wrapped around your waist in a sudden embrace - pulling you tightly against him.*

"Awee! Are you mad?" *he murmured softly into your ear while dragging his lips along its outline- continuing on with seductive whispering* "How 'bout I let you cool off at my place hm?"
